intent: Upgrade the plumbline CI gate pin to the latest release, v0.4.1, in .github/workflows/plumbline.yml. The pin was a floating '@v1' tag that does not resolve (plumbline has no v1 release; latest is v0.4.1), so the gate was effectively not running a real pinned version. Pin it explicitly to @v0.4.1 to match the rest of the fleet and get the current gate behavior (base_sha pinning + accept-rederived-merge-base, which ends the stale-base re-stamp tax). Version-string change only; the gate logic lives in the plumbline package, not here. Touches .github/workflows/** (a protected path) so self_modifying=true and it routes to human review, correct for a change to the enforcement pipeline.
